name: Huadeng Yingye
source:
She is an outgoing and carefree Illuminator, born and raised in Earthcaress Beacon, sometimes a bit naive, but overall easy to get along with. However, her characteristics will make others occasionally forget that she is actually an experienced Arboranger.

[spoiler]It turns out that the actual Lanteria is a fusion of souls, and also a manufactured heroine.

In reality, Lanteria has become the head of Earthcaress beacon and she bears the expectations of the Beacon's Illuminators such as Tranquillia.[/spoiler]
